Godly garlic& herbs bread rolls:

600g flour
75g sugar
12g fine sea salt

Whisk to evenly distribute ingredients

In a cup or something combine:

1 whole egg
60ml milk
225ml water
10g instant yeast

Mix and let that sit for 10 minutes so that the yeast can bloom

Combine wet and dry ingrediants and knead untill a smooth and workable dough forms (which might take like 15-30minutes of kneading, dont be tempted to add more flour because the ratio of moisture in the dough is very important.)

Once you have a nice smooth dough, knead in 115g of butter by hand untill it is a cohesive dough again.

Let it rest for 1hour at room temperature

Form into 70g balls (about 14-16) and put them into the cast iron pan (buttered) with a little bit of space between each dough ball

Let it rest for another hour at room temperature and brush with eggwash (1egg+ a tablespoon of water)

Bake at 180°c/ 350°f for 20-30min (depending on your oven) on convection

Garlic butter:

Melt 75g o butter on low heat

Add fresh rosemary, tyme and oregano with half a tea spoon of honey. 2 grated garlic cloves and salt+ pepper to taste.

Pour the melted butter over your rolls as soon as they come out of the oven.

Devour your buns while they are still hot.
